description: PSLQ relation search at 70 decimal digits of mpmath precision for the antisymmetric depth-3 generator X = Cl_3(2π/5) - Cl_3(4π/5) against three candidate bases of weight-3 periods. PSLQ tolerance 1e-65, max integer coefficient norm 1e8. No relation found in any basis — certifies X is INDEPENDENT of standard depth-3 constants (ζ(3), π³, π·log²(φ), log³(φ), etc.) up to the search bound. Strong evidence that X is the genuinely-new depth-3 generator at ζ_5 over Q(ζ_5).
conclusion: No ℚ-linear relation found in any candidate basis up to coefficient norm 1e8. X is numerically certified independent of the standard depth-3 weight-3 period basis. This is strong evidence (not proof) that X represents the genuinely-new 1-dim depth-3 generator of K_5^ind(Q(ζ_5)) ⊗ Q's regulator image, modulo the ζ(3)-line.
